clauses.assertion: A first-run native TV persists an installation nonce and asks the backend to create a hashed single-active eight-character challenge that expires within eight minutes.

tests.name: first run persists an installation nonce and creates a challenge
unpaired TV challenge is hashed, short-lived, deep-linked, and pending until owner claim

clauses.assertion: The QR contains only the validated africlub My TVs owner-pairing deep link with the exact displayed challenge; alternate schemes, paths, parameters, or mismatched codes fail closed.

tests.name: validates owner deep-link pairing payloads and credentials

clauses.assertion: The unpaired TV displays its generated QR and challenge but accepts no secret input; participant discovery and projections contain no pairing code or credential.

tests.name: TV shows a generated challenge instead of accepting a secret
participant discovery is code-free and source-governed

clauses.assertion: Possession of the challenge and installation nonce cannot pair the TV; exchange remains pending until an authenticated authorized owner claims the installation.

tests.name: pending owner claim keeps the same challenge
unpaired TV challenge is hashed, short-lived, deep-linked, and pending until owner claim

clauses.assertion: After owner claim, the same installation exchanges exactly once for a bounded credential, stores it through secure storage, binds a least-privilege TV identity, and fetches only its role-safe projection.

tests.name: owner claim exchanges once, stores credential, and fetches projection
secure-write retry does not exchange a one-time credential twice
TV receives one revocable credential exactly once after owner claim

clauses.assertion: A successful exchange clears the challenge from native-TV runtime state, and owner/participant/TV projections never return the raw credential, pairing code, or challenge.

tests.name: owner claim exchanges once, stores credential, and fetches projection
owner claim creates a complete scoped inventory item without pairing or credential material

clauses.assertion: Revocation clears the local credential, realtime binding, and projection; recovery requires a fresh native-TV bootstrap challenge and issues a replacement credential exactly once.

tests.name: revocation deletes the credential and fails closed
revoking a TV credential clears its Realtime identity and event access
owner rename, revocation, and credential recovery are idempotent and audited once
